:::{#sol-prac-exp-mle-mle}

Setting $\score(\pmean; \vx) = 0$:

$$
\ba
0 &= \frac{n}{\pmean^2}\paren{\rvarbar - \pmean}
&& \text{(score)}
\\
0 &= \rvarbar - \pmean
&& \text{(multiply both sides by $\tfrac{\pmean^2}{n}$)}
\\
\hat\pmean_{ML} &= \rvarbar
&& \text{(add $\pmean$ to both sides)}
\ea
$$

:::
